name: bukti-launch
description: Evidence-gated launch copywriting team: the lead builds a fact ledger from the source manifest, brief and rules and triages unsupported claims into delete/replace/escalate; the writer drafts only from authorized facts with complete claim-to-source citations; the reviewer issues canonical verdicts (PASS, PASS_WITH_NOTES, REVISE, ESCALATE) and never passes a factual claim whose citation is incomplete, within a strict 3-review-pass budget

displayDescription.en: Three-role evidence-gated launch copy pipeline: the lead builds a fact ledger and format plan, the writer drafts only from authorized facts with claim-to-source mapping, and the reviewer audits sources, facts, tone, advertising rules and halal applicability, with at most 3 review passes before human escalation
displayDescription.zh: 证据文案团队：主理人建事实台账，撰写师仅凭授权事实成稿，审核师核查来源、语气、广告与清真适用性。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 请依据我的来源清单、brief 和规则，先建事实台账，再按格式撰写带证据映射的发布文案
defaultInitPrompt.en: Read my source manifest, brief and rules; build the fact ledger first, then draft per format with claim-to-source mapping
